title: China Market Crash: The Reflexive Cascade
objective: Deconstruct China's 2026 stock market crash as a high-stakes, visually dynamic explainer of reflexive deleveraging and retail herd panic with rich multi-beat visual choreography.
audience: Curious finance and tech viewers on mobile looking for a gripping, cinematic narrative behind market crashes.

message.core_message: When millions of retail traders buy stocks on triple leverage, a tiny dip triggers automated liquidation and a stampede where state bailouts cannot print confidence.
key_points: Retail euphoria drove massive margin borrowing
A 2% dip triggered automatic 1/L collateral wipeouts
90% retail dominance created an instantaneous panic stampede
State ETF bailouts cannot arrest reflexive deleveraging without confidence

constraints: Reel safe margins respected (10% top, 20% bottom)
Anti-Laziness Mandate: Zero static visual freezes while narration speaks
Default light theme: Off-white canvas with warm, punchy, high-contrast colors

research.reason: Derived from validated research dossier in projects/china-market-crash-2026/research.json

creative_directions.name: Warm High-Contrast Editorial Financial Thriller
creative_directions.concept: A sophisticated light-canvas financial thriller where a warm ivory editorial surface (#FBFBFA) stages a smartphone trading terminal, radial wipeout gauges, plunging order-book depth bars, and monumental $2.4T takeaway cards with rich, vibrant contrast colors (vermilion, ultramarine, amber, emerald).

visual_identity.palette: Warm ivory base (#FBFBFA), crisp white cards (#FFFFFF), deep charcoal ink (#111827), punchy vermilion (#E11D48), electric ultramarine (#1D4ED8), marigold amber (#F59E0B), emerald (#059669)
visual_identity.typography: Playfair Display / Oswald headings, Inter body, JetBrains Mono telemetry metrics
visual_identity.texture: Subtle editorial paper grain and crisp frosted glass cards

signature_moves: Panic order-book waterfall with live volume counter
motion_language.transitions: Clean transparent cuts and coordinated wipeouts (zero transition whooshes)

composition.approach: Vertical 9:16 layout with top HUD telemetry, central interactive stage viewport, and bottom status badge

creative_directions.pacing: Continuous visual evolution every 2-3 seconds matching spoken keywords and metrics
creative_directions.why_it_fits: Delivers maximum retention on mobile reels with stunning high-contrast clarity on light backgrounds.

creative_directions.name: Swiss Modern Analytical Fact Sheet
creative_directions.concept: A rigid Swiss-style analytical layout on cool white (#F8F9FA) with heavy grotesk typography and monochrome architecture.

visual_identity.palette: Clean paper (#F8F9FA), jet black (#09090B), signal crimson (#EF4444)
visual_identity.typography: Heavy sans display, clean mono body

creative_directions.why_it_fits: Objective and stark, but less visually layered and dynamic than the warm editorial thriller.

success_criteria: Native 720x1280 composition with proper safe areas
Multi-beat visual choreographies with zero static freezes
Dim themed background music bed and tactile micro-sfx
Audio passes EBU R128 loudness requirements
